matched_pairs.b_evidence_quote: We propose to add a modulating factor (1−pt)γ to the cross entropy loss, with tunable focusing parameter γ≥ 0. We define the focal loss as: FL(pt) =−(1−pt)γ log(pt).
we design a simple one-stage object detector called RetinaNet, named for its dense sampling of object locations in an input image.
Its design features an efficient in-network feature pyramid and use of anchor boxes. We use translation-invariant anchor boxes similar to those in the RPN variant in [20].
We adopt the Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) from [20] as the backbone network for RetinaNet. In brief, FPN augments a standard convolutional network with a top-down pathway and lateral connections
Following [20], we build FPN on top of the ResNet architecture [16]. We experiment with ResNet-50-FPN and ResNet-101-FPN backbones.
The top predictions from all levels are merged and non-maximum suppression with a threshold of 0.5 is applied to yield the final detections.
We present experimental results on the bounding box detection track of the challenging COCO benchmark [21].
the first stage generates a sparse set of candidate object locations and the second stage classifies each candidate location as one of the foreground classes or as background
